thesis: The page is a paper time card: every section is a stamped row on the card, and the signature is the red ink punch that marks each slot as you scroll.

signature.name: Time Card Punch
signature.summary: A vertical time rail with monospaced timestamp pills that ink in as you scroll; the footer is the 12:00 punch-out stamp.

motion.intro: Time card slides up; 08:00 stamp presses in with scale pulse, 800ms, skippable.
stories: Timestamp pills ink in (opacity + scale pulse) as rail draws down on scroll.
Marquee photos drift left continuously; pause on hover/focus.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX(0→1), 200ms.
